text: I was impressed during the first free week, so I bought the yearly membership. The Growth in good experiences however, fell short - and pretty early up in the using of this app as well.  If it would be possible to request a refund after using this for almost 3 months now, I would definitely do it. I've not been that active on the app for the last 2 months, because the progress is uninspiring, early steps feel stupid (things most of us do unconsciously already on a daily basis) and the actual "challenging steps" are the ones you'd need to be more flexible. Working out each and every day is sometimes physically impossible. I also feel like you can't really have a "vacation" from this app, or you'll lose your streaks you've worked so hard to build up - on things you honestly shouldn't be required to complete on a daily basis.  All this gather up to an end which feels like a total waste of money. I've used various self-motivator apps, both free and those with a monthly fee, but Fabulous is so far the only one with a really pretty cover, yet uninspiring, very slow and unsatisfying way of progress. There is seemingly no way to "kickstart" your self-improvement, even if needed.
author: Googlen käyttäjä
developer_reply: Hi Niko, thanks for taking the time to share your honest feedback. We apologize if the app hasn't served the purpose you had initially hoped for. We're constantly working to improve the app based on user feedback and we currently have yours noted. If possible, we'd like to hear more about your experience. You can reach us at hello@thefabulous.co
